title.zh: 有理等离子体色散极点

summary: Return ordered J4/J8 tables or the precision-corrected J12/I16/K8 pole-residue table.

identity.definition: Z_J(z)=sum_j bzj[j]/(z-czj[j]); paired tables obey sum b=-1,sum bc=0,sum bc^2=-1/2 within binary64 precision. J12 regenerates the prescribed Padé relation at 80 digits, checked against a 120-digit construction before rounding to binary64; the J4/J8 tabulated values are kept as given.
identity.model: Explicit rational approximation or two-Gaussian representation for magnetized kinetic response.
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: J
inputs.description: Number of rational terms in Z(z)=sum_j bzj/(z-czj).
inputs.constraints: Exactly4,8 or12; J12/I16/K8 table is intentionally regenerated at high precision and rounded to binary64.

outputs.name: bzj
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned operator result.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: czj
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned operator result.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: J in{4,8,12}; causal physical mapping must still handle the sign of parallel k.
supported: J in{4,8,12}; causal physical mapping must still handle the sign of parallel k.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; unsupported J is rejected without a table fallback.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Pure Python numeric errors propagate with operation context; no the reference runtime or source-runtime process is invoked.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative solve is performed by fixed-table lookup; J12 construction is validated by the separate pure mpmath Padé operator.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned when validation or table loading fails.

example.description: Return a pure-Python J-pole table and inspect its moments.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion import magnetized
r = magnetized.pole_coefficients(8)
assert r.state['bzj'].size == 8
example.expected: PASS: .venv/bin/python returns the declared table without the declared local Python runtime.

scope: First three asymptotic moments retain the1e-10 gate; J12 raw80/120 construction yields stable binary64 coefficients.
Independent Z values and resolved kinetic responses bound the corrected J12 table; J4/J8 lower-order approximation errors remain explicit diagnostics.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; the pure-Python execution runs on this macOS checkout without the declared local Python runtime.
known_limitations: Local technical development; human scientific endorsement and publication clearance remain pending.
Finite harmonic N and rational-pole J approximations require independent convergence checks for a new physical regime.
Passing bounded response, state and backward-error tests does not establish unique physical-mode tracking, all-root forward accuracy or visual acceptance.
Lower-half-plane poles define a rational approximation; its global strong-damping accuracy is not established by bounded upper-half-plane response tests.
The pure-Python example and bounded verification run on this macOS host; arbitrary parameter regimes remain outside the evidence.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
